text:
Hochwohlgebohrner Herr
Hochzuverehrender Herr Kriegs und Forst Raths
In dem Augenblicke, wo Sr Durchlaucht der
Fürst mit dem alten Herrn in die Kirche
fahren befehlen Sie mir nach Euer Hochwohl¬
gebohren, unter Höchst Ihrer Empfehlung
anliegenden Brief zu senden. Höchstdiesel¬
ben würden gerne selbst geschrieben, ha¬
ben, wenn nicht schon in einer Stunde die
Ordonanz abgiengen.
der alte Fürst befinden sich für Ihr Alten
sehr wohl, und zeigen ausnehmend vieles
Ablachement für meinen gnädigsten
Herren. Ich wünsche vom Herzen, daß Euer

Hochwohlgebohren sich recht wohl befinden
mögten, empfehle mich zu fernern
Gewogenheit und habe die Ehre in voll¬
kommenster Verehrung zu beharren:
Euer Hochwohlgebohren,
Öhringen den 7ten Juli
1805.
unterthäniger Diener
A: Hahn
die Rükkunft nach Breslau
ist ohnfehlbar d 25ten bestimmt!

translation.en:
Right Honourable Sir, Highly Honoured Sir Councillor of War and Forests! At the very moment when His Serene Highness the Prince is driving to church with the old gentleman, he commands me to send to Your Right Honourable, with his most high compliments, the enclosed letter. He would gladly have written himself, had not the ordonnance been departing within the hour.

The old Prince finds himself, for his age, very well, and shows exceedingly much [uncertain: attachment] for my most gracious Lord. I wish from the heart that Your

Right Honourable may find yourself in right good health; I commend myself to your continued favour and have the honour to persist in most perfect veneration: Your Right Honourable's, Öhringen, the 7th of July 1805.

humble and obedient servant A: Hahn — the return to Breslau is fixed, without fail, for the 25th!

text_english:
Right Honourable Sir, Highly Honoured Sir Councillor of War and Forests! At the very moment when His Serene Highness the Prince is driving to church with the old gentleman, he commands me to send to Your Right Honourable, with his most high compliments, the enclosed letter. He would gladly have written himself, had not the ordonnance been departing within the hour.

The old Prince finds himself, for his age, very well, and shows exceedingly much [uncertain: attachment] for my most gracious Lord. I wish from the heart that Your

Right Honourable may find yourself in right good health; I commend myself to your continued favour and have the honour to persist in most perfect veneration: Your Right Honourable's, Öhringen, the 7th of July 1805.

humble and obedient servant A: Hahn — the return to Breslau is fixed, without fail, for the 25th!
summary_en: Hahn, writing on the Prince's behalf as His Serene Highness sets off to church with the old gentleman, forwards an enclosed letter with the Prince's compliments, explaining that he would have written himself had the ordonnance not been leaving within the hour. Reports that the old Prince is very well for his age and much attached to his most gracious Lord, and notes that the return to Breslau is fixed for the 25th.
summary_de: Im Auftrag des Fürsten, der eben mit dem alten Herrn zur Kirche fährt, übersendet Hahn ein beigeschlossenes Schreiben nebst Komplimenten; der Fürst hätte selbst geschrieben, wäre die Ordonnanz nicht binnen einer Stunde abgegangen. Der alte Fürst befinde sich für sein Alter sehr wohl und zeige seinem gnädigsten Herrn ausnehmend viel Anhänglichkeit. Höflichkeitswünsche für Triebenfelds Gesundheit; die Rückkehr nach Breslau ist unfehlbar auf den 25. festgesetzt.
